LanguageData.LP_Ogre.label: ogre
LanguageData.LP_Ogre.description: A crude giant a head and shoulders above ordinary people, with tawny skin, a thick jaw and heavy brow ridges. Ogres are immensely strong and can send someone flying with one club swing; but their minds aren't sharp: slow research, slow learning, always lowballed in trade, and ugly too. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_Ogre.descriptionShort: Inheritable huge race. Body size ×1.6 (health ×1.3, melee ×1.18), high melee damage; research ×50%, slow learner, lowballed, hot-tempered, ugly.
